title: Tenant metrics blackout: repair live-panel stitching, trace-linker and ingestion watermark skew
creator: Maya Patel
description: Multiple customers reported missing KPI time-series and blank live-panel widgets during a regional incident. Symptoms included: intermittent zeroed timeseries, live-panels failing to refresh, and traces not linking to dashboard tiles. Root cause appears to be a watermark skew in tenant ingestion and an edge case in the live-panel stitcher that drops partial shards when KV cache resyncs overlap with reindex windows. This ticket coordinates triage, temporary mitigation, and a permanent patch to the stitcher + trace linking logic.
reproduction_steps: Simulate tenant ingestion backlog by delaying shard consumer for 60s
Trigger KV cache resync on same tenant during backlog window
Open console Live Panel for tenant and query 1h window; observe missing time buckets
Open trace detail from a sampled request and attempt to link to dashboard tile; check missing trace-to-metric correlation
Run backfill tool with default window; verify whether patched stitching recovers broken tiles
investigation_summary: 02-20: Oncall observed missing metric buckets for tenant:acme-corp across us-west-2 during an autoscaling event
02-21: Identified ingestion watermark skew on shard-7 where watermark advanced while consumer checkpoint lagged — caused time-series tombstoning in indexer
02-22: Live-panel stitcher has a race when reindex metadata epoch changes mid-aggregation leading to dropped partial series
02-24: Trace linker relied on metric document IDs that were GC'ed by tombstone path; correlation fails when tombstoning occurs
Perf impact: median panel load latency increased by 2.8x for affected tenants during recovery windows
mitigation_actions: 02-21 23:40: Rolled forward temporary hold on tombstone compaction for affected tenants (manual flag) - reduces data loss window
02-22 04:12: Enabled conservative reindexing (serial mode) for tenants with high checkpoint lag
02-22 08:30: Deployed a hotfix to the live-panel frontend to show cached snapshots and a user-facing message while backend recovers
02-23 01:00: Run ad-hoc rehydrate script (scripts/rehydrate_metrics.sh) for top 5 impacted customers - links: https://github.com/redwood/ops-scripts/pull/72
Customer comms: Sent interim status to affected accounts with temporary SLA credits offered
proposed_fix: Add epoch-aware merging to live-panel stitcher so partial shards that cross resync boundaries are preserved
Make trace-linker resilient to tombstoned metric IDs by falling back to time-range correlation and span metadata matching
Improve ingestion checkpointing to avoid watermark regressions: add a grace window and replays for late-arriving events
Add end-to-end integration tests simulating KV cache resync + reindex overlap
Ship as patch release console-2026.03.1 and schedule gradual rollout with canary tenants
postmortem_actions: Implement dashboard-level health signals and automated rollback if stitcher error rate > 0.5%
Add SLA-triggered automated rehydrate for tenants exceeding missing-bucket threshold
Bake a tenant-specific telemetry dashboard for checkpoint lag and watermark skew
Schedule oncall training and update incident playbook with KV cache resync checklist
